column1: Sam is an independent designer, art director, and creative consultant helping organizations tell their complex stories in approachable ways.

He helped create the Genome brand and magazine, helped redesign [foreignaffairs.com](http://foreignaffairs.com/) and [afar.com](https://afar.com/), and collaborated with [Big Medium](https://bigmedium.com/) to help bring design systems to life for [Cigna](https://www.cigna.com/), [Principal](https://www.principal.com/), and [Ulta](https://www.ulta.com/). His work has been recognized by the [Society of Publication Designers](http://www.spd.org/), [Communication Arts](http://www.commarts.com/), [Print](http://www.printmag.com/), and [Graphis](https://www.graphis.com/), and he was selected to sit on the design jury for the SPD annual design competition.
